# https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values-5/#tree-counting
- name: layout.css.tree-counting-functions.enabled
  type: RelaxedAtomicBool
  value: true
  mirror: always
  rust: true

# Whether to enable the CSS alpha() color function.
# https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-5/#relative-alpha
- name: layout.css.alpha-color-function.enabled
  type: RelaxedAtomicBool
  value: true
  mirror: alway

testing/web-platform/meta/__dir__.ini.body:
prefs: [layout.disable-pixel-alignment:true, network.dns.disableIPv6:true, layout.css.tree-counting-functions.enabled:true, layout.css.supports.at-rule.enabled:true, dom.forms.html_color_picker.enabled:true]
lsan-allowed: [alloc::alloc::alloc, alloc::alloc::realloc, js_pod_malloc, js_pod_calloc, js_pod_realloc, js_arena_calloc,js_pod_arena_calloc, maybe_pod_calloc, pod_calloc, make_zeroed_pod_array, js_arena_malloc, js_arena_realloc, CompileUtf8]
leak-threshold:
  if (os == "mac"): [tab:10000, gmplugin:20000, default:2100, rdd:400]
  [tab:10000, gpu: 10000, gmplugin:20000, rdd:400, default:16000]

conclusion: Root WPT metadata enables tree-counting for dom/nodes/moveBefore too; no new page-specific preference metadata required. Default browser feature availability is separate from WPT preference configuration.
